# Nessebar Lens

Fine art, archive, and film photography of Old Town Nessebar, Bulgaria, by a
single photographer working across three decades. Photographs are sold as
museum-quality giclée prints produced by a print partner, and as high-resolution
digital downloads. There is no subscription, no account, and no cart to persist:
checkout is a single Stripe-hosted page.

The canonical machine-readable index of this site is the sitemap:
https://nessebarlens.com/sitemap.xml

## Pages

- [Home](https://nessebarlens.com/): The featured photograph and an entry point
  to each of the three galleries.
- [Fine Art](https://nessebarlens.com/fine-art): The curated portfolio —
  composed architecture, atmospheric coastlines, and colour graded for print.
- [Archive](https://nessebarlens.com/archive): Photojournalistic work: everyday
  street life in Nessebar over thirty years.
- [Film Photography](https://nessebarlens.com/film): Analog 35mm and 120 film
  negatives, unedited grain and light leaks included.
- [Our Story](https://nessebarlens.com/story): How the three bodies of work
  relate, and how a print is made.
- [Contact](https://nessebarlens.com/contact): Direct contact with the studio
  about a print, a licence, or an order.

## Individual photographs

Each photograph has its own page at `/prints/{slug}` carrying the title, the
full description, the print sizes available, and the price. The complete list is
in the sitemap; it is not repeated here because it changes with every publish.

## Not indexed

The checkout pages (`/checkout/success`, `/checkout/cancel`) are per-session and
carry `noindex`. They are not in the sitemap and should not be requested.
